blind.description: A stylized cartoon-style wizard or witch hat resting directly on the ground. It features a wide, wavy circular brim, a creased conical crown that curves slightly and tapers to a bent point, and a brown leather band around the base with a golden rectangular buckle. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating elements.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a concentric circular purple disc with an undulating rim, centered on the gathered cone of the crown, showing the brown belt and buckle along the lower edge and casting a distinct pointed shadow of the tip toward the top.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.2 to 1.5 feet tall (about 1/4 to 1/5 of the figure's 5 ft 9 in height) and approximately 1.5 to 2 feet in diameter across the brim.

notes: crown is slightly squatter / more bent than catalog proportions
underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
